thesis: Eric Irvin argues that investors should categorize all investments into two buckets: risk reducers and return enhancers, rather than viewing them simply as stocks or bonds. He explains that his philosophy evolved from his experience as an advisor, where he allocated 50% to 60% of client assets to alternatives to create absolute return strategies that could serve as either risk reducers or return enhancers depending on their specific characteristics.
